descriptions.text: The MetaSea "Round" position contract let users open a position with USDC and then redeemPosition() to receive SEA rewards funded by a separate SEA distributor. The redemption accounting was flawed: opening a position and immediately redeeming paid out more SEA from the distributor than the economics justified, letting the attacker repeatedly mint a profit each loop. Backed by an Aave V3 USDT flash loan, the attacker buys a little SEA on the SEA/USDT pool, opens a 3,000 USDC position, redeems it for distributor SEA, and dumps the SEA back to USDT, looping 12 times to drain ~245K SEA from the distributor and net ~$13.9K USDT after repaying the flash loan. The root cause is a business-logic/accounting flaw in the open-then-redeem flow that over-credits SEA rewards relative to the deposited value. Vulnerable code snippet: Attack Tx: https://arbiscan.io/tx/0x001cb16e17c4c5a5c4d02423c9e9b2f2b11ab6b2a1baf2ba53b8fcaf06167716 Analysis: https://anomly.rs/metasea-redeemposition-distributor-drain-arb-2026-05-17

SEA Token on Arbitrum was exploited through a flashloan-enabled price manipulation attack due to a protocol logic flaw in its Solidity smart contract. The attacker used a flash loan to artificially manipulate the token price (likely via liquidity pool imbalance or oracle dependency), allowing unauthorized extraction of approximately $153,000 in value.

SEA Token's MetaSea round protocol on Arbitrum was exploited in May 2026. The attacker used a flash loan to repeatedly open and immediately redeem positions, draining reward tokens from a flawed settlement adapter and selling them for profit. Approximately $153,000 in value was extracted. The vulnerable settlement adapter allowed immediate redemption of positions that credited reward tokens (SEA) based on the distributor's current accumulated balance, not user-time-weighted participation. There was no block or time lock preventing atomic open and redeem. Distributor payouts were unthrottled, so a flash-loan-funded loop could sweep the entire pending pool.
